_comment: PLACEHOLDER SET (10) — matches DailyQuestionService._fallbackBank so derivation stays consistent before seeding.
Agent 3 (or the human) should expand this to 365 prompts in ONE batch: categories ldr / playful / deep / memory.

Seeding: when the final bank lands, generate supabase/seed_daily_questions.sql (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) from this file and run it once in the Supabase SQL editor. Rows are read-only to clients; the app derives question-of-the-day as an index into ORDER BY id.

questions.text: What's a small thing they did today that made you smile?
If you could teleport to them for one hour, what would you do?
What's a song that reminds you of them right now?
What is something you are looking forward to doing together?
What's one thing you learned about yourself this week?
Describe your perfect lazy day together.
What is a memory of us you replay the most?
What's something you want to tell them but keep forgetting to?
Which timezone moment is hardest: waking up alone or falling asleep alone?
What's a dish you want to cook for them someday?
